crew_workspace_setup_ask_name: First question of a new crewmate's setup chat. The crewmate speaks in the first person.
crew_workspace_setup_ask_project: Third question of the setup chat; the user's projects follow as options.
crew_workspace_setup_ask_role: Second question of the setup chat; options follow.
crew_workspace_setup_change_title: Option that restarts the setup from the name.
crew_workspace_setup_confirm_title: Option that confirms the setup summary.
crew_workspace_setup_default_role: Role shown in the setup summary when none was saved; reads after 'I'll' (infinitive in pt-BR).
crew_workspace_setup_project_other_subti: Subtitle of 'Something else' in the project question.
crew_workspace_setup_role_changelog_subt: Subtitle of the changelog role option in the setup chat.
crew_workspace_setup_role_changelog_titl: Role option of the setup chat; saved as the role and read in the summary after 'I'll'.
crew_workspace_setup_role_ci_subtitle: Subtitle of the CI role option in the setup chat.
crew_workspace_setup_role_ci_title: Role option of the setup chat; saved as the role and read in the summary after 'I'll'.
crew_workspace_setup_role_other_subtitle: Subtitle of 'Something else' in the role question.
crew_workspace_setup_role_review_subtitl: Subtitle of the review role option in the setup chat.
crew_workspace_setup_role_review_title: Role option of the setup chat. The text becomes the crewmate's saved role, and the summary sentence reads 'I'll review every PR': start it with a verb in the infinitive.
crew_workspace_setup_skip: The user's replayed answer in the setup chat when the project step was skipped.
crew_workspace_setup_something_else: Option that lets the user type their own answer, in the role and project questions of the setup chat.
crew_workspace_setup_summary: Summary bubble of the setup chat without a project. {name} is shown in bold; {role} starts lowercase and is a verb phrase; {mode} is the name of the permission mode, shown in bold.
crew_workspace_setup_summary_project: Summary bubble of the setup chat with a project. {name} and {project} are shown in bold; {role} is a verb phrase; {mode} is the name of the permission mode, shown in bold.
